item.title: Hort Q&A: Is it time to plant my garden?
item.description: Well, that depends on what you like to grow! Cool season garden vegetable planting time is here! So, what does that include? Some veggies can be planted now and some need to wait. Cool season crops include: cabbage, kale, broccoli, turnips, collards, spinach, peas, carrots, onions, potatoes, and radish among others.

item.title: Swine shine: Livestock show wraps up
item.description: Competitions in the Pottawatomie County Junior Livestock Show concluded Thursday with the swine show at the Expo Center in Shawnee.

item.title: The Heart of the hunt: How Heather Hulsey is making Shawnee a vintage destination
item.description: SHAWNEE - The first thing you notice when you walk into T-Box Antiques isn’t the scale of the place—though the sheer acreage of history is enough to make your head spin—it’s the sense of order amidst the chaos. And at the heart of that order is Heather Hulsey.

item.title: Getman's late shot lifts Bison over East Central to end season
item.description: Oklahoma Baptist closed its season in dramatic fashion on Senior Night, edging East Central 67–66 inside a packed Noble Complex crowd of 618.

item.title: OBU men capture 16th consecutive win at Rangers' expense
item.description: ALVA - The No. 7-ranked (NABC) Oklahoma Baptist men’s basketball team extended its winning streak to 16 games with a 71-59 victory over Northwestern Oklahoma State.

item.title: SHS standout Kiley Sartin earns prestigious honors as 2026 Academic All-Stater and National Merit Finalist
item.description: SHAWNEE — Shawnee High School senior Kiley Sartin has been recognized among the state and nation’s top academic achievers, earning distinction as a 2026 Oklahoma Academic All-Stater and a 2026 National Merit Finalist. Selected as one of only 100 Academic All-State scholars statewide, Sartin represents the highest level of academic excellence in Oklahoma public schools.

item.title: Zoo debuts wildlife photography exhibit at Zoozeum
item.description: See the Oklahoma City Zoo, its wildlife, and gardens through the eyes of talented photographers while discovering the Zoo’s new exhibit, OKC Zoo Photo Crew: Best of 2025. This artistic display represents favorite moments photographed by OKC Zoo Photo Crew members, volunteer photographers, from 2025.

item.title: Bison women struggle offensively in road loss at NWOSU
item.description: ALVA, Okla. – Cold shooting and early offensive droughts proved costly on Thursday night as Oklahoma Baptist fell 59–38 to Northwestern Oklahoma State inside Percefull Fieldhouse.

item.title: Bison men earn 17th straight victory by clipping East Central 87-62
item.description: Behind a dominant second-half surge, the No. 7-ranked (NABC) Oklahoma Baptist men’s basketball team rolled past East Central, 87-62, Saturday night at the Noble Complex.

item.title: Your next step starts here: PLS focuses on Upward Mobility this March
item.description: Cleveland, McClain, Pottawatomie Counties - Throughout the month of March, Pioneer Library System (PLS) invites adults across its service area to explore these upward mobility resources by visiting their local library or accessing tools online. PLS is highlighting its system-wide focus on Upward Mobility, emphasizing resources that support adult learners, job seekers, and individuals working to advance their careers and skills.
